serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Anecdotes is an Agentic GRC platform that delivers continuous compliance for enterprises managing GRC at scale. Built on an audit-grade data foundation, it automates evidence collection, maps controls across 60+ industry frameworks and custom policies, and gives teams real-time visibility into their risk and compliance posture. Where traditional tools automate workflows, Anecdotes agents execute them end to end, replacing point-in-time assessments with continuous monitoring. 
Anecdotes is the first agentic GRC platform to achieve FedRAMP 20x Class C (Moderate) Certification, bringing Continuous Control Monitoring to organizations operating under federal cloud security standards.
